role: post-observation intervention prompted by completed R damage; not a new training comparison or original confirmation

fixed_scope.mu: expert-specific mean original TRAIN hidden, no target/loss/EVAL fitting
fixed_scope.eval: same complete EVAL and fixed supported low/high cohorts as C

operation: delta_full(h)=U D h; delta_constant=U D mu; delta_centered(h)=U D(h-mu)

predictions.constant_response_dominates: constant-only reproduces most full damage; removing it (centered-only) restores performance toward zero; small residual loss interaction
predictions.input_dependent_response_dominates: centered-only reproduces most full damage; constant-only stays near zero; small residual loss interaction
predictions.nonlinear_interaction_dominates: neither component alone reproduces full damage; Lfull-Lconstant-Lcentered+Lzero is large; or components cancel strongly
predictions.mixed_or_unidentified: components and interaction are comparable or seed/metric patterns conflict; no single-cause conclusion

registered_primary_readout: overall loss damage relative to zero; fixed low-feature conditional result is also reported
guards: original zero/full per-position loss arrays reproduced exactly
same target, route, head, normalization, eval membership and loss reduction in all four states
boundary: identifies functional response components at this frozen checkpoint; no common semantics, no optimizer history or full training root-cause proof
